title: NMRx source registry (normalized)
_permission_note: This registry is a research directory. Presence here grants nothing. Only nmrx/data/access_policy.json grants a host, and the cloud environment's own Allowed-domains setting can still refuse.
_rights_note: rights.status records what provider documentation SAYS, not that reuse is authorized. 'unverified' and 'open_unverified' are real states and must not be upgraded without reading the licence text on the exact data.
